definition.question: How extensive is state failure, coup-driven instability and insurgent territorial control across Mali, Burkina Faso, Niger, Sudan, Ethiopia and Somalia?
definition.low_end: Stable civilian governments with monopoly on force and insurgencies contained to peripheral areas.
definition.high_end: Multiple simultaneous state collapses with juntas and jihadist/insurgent groups controlling large territories and threatening capitals across the Sahel and Horn.
